**Date:** [11 July 1879]  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54921: 101

[[To Alexander Macmillan](people/person_939.qmd)]

I send herewith the other tale, Selma’s Secret Sighs in a Christmas number[^1]

C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Postcard addressed to 'A Macmillan Esq/ 30 Bedford Street/ Covent Garden/ London E C.' and postmarked Winchester, 11 July 1879.
[^2]: CMY was assembling the stories which were republished as *Bye-Words* (1880).
